name: cover
prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Redraw this chapter COVER as ONE portrait1024x1536 preschool coloring page. Remove ALL title words and any lettering. Preserve Elder hedgehog with round spectacles on lower-left, one paw pointing upward, and small PinPin on lower-right attentively watching him. Behind them, a clearly framed WALL PAINTING shows a kindly pregnant human woman in a simple long robe, one hand above and one below her rounded belly, with a small baby cradle beside her and two large leaf motifs. The woman and cradle are explicitly a flat mural behind the hedgehogs, not extra living characters in the room. Keep broad root-arch outline over the mural; remove tiny plants, wheat, wildlife, mosaic, patterns and stone textures. Make all figures and mural shapes large, simple and colorable for a FOUR-YEAR-OLD. Entire page is OPAQUE PURE WHITE #FFFFFF with bold smooth BLACK outlines only, no transparency. Very large enclosed white areas, simple zigzag hedgehog quill silhouettes, minimal garment folds. Tiny black pupils allowed; no filled dark bodies or shadows. Absolutely no grey, shading, gradients, hatching, color, text, numbers, texture, panels or decorative border. Friendly faces and comfortable print margins.

review.notes: Source mural remains clear flat background; pregnant robed woman and cradle simplified respectfully, Elder points and child watches. No title text.
